name: topic.earth
short_description: Interactive Earth dashboard for climate simulation, regional initiatives, space context, and sustainable action.
long_description: topic.earth is an interactive Earth dashboard that popularizes climate systems, global warming scenarios, regional initiatives, tipping points, AMOC, and space context. It combines simulation, curated topics, AI-assisted research, and user proposals to help people understand risks and discover sustainable action.

connection.security_note: The first MCP server is read-only and exposes only safe user assistance tools. It does not publish, update, delete, or save topic.earth content.

topic_summary.name: Topic Summary
topic_summary.description: Summarizes a topic.earth item with concise context and why it matters.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only reads the selected topic text and metadata to produce a summary. It does not create, update, delete, publish, or save topic content.
justifications.purpose: Helps users understand a selected topic.earth item without modifying published content.
justifications.user_benefit: Provides concise context and improves accessibility for climate and regional topics.
justifications.data_access: Uses only the topic text and metadata provided by the user or current app view.

translate_to_french.name: Translate to French
translate_to_french.description: Translates selected topic.earth UI or topic text to French while preserving names, numbers, dates, and source titles.

justifications.read_only_justification: This tool only reads selected text and returns a French translation. It does not modify the original interface, selected text, or topic record.
justifications.purpose: Translates selected topic.earth text into French for comprehension and reading support.
justifications.user_benefit: Makes climate, regional, and initiative content easier to study in French.
justifications.data_access: Uses only the selected text supplied by the user or current app view.

commerce.note: topic.earth is an educational app. It does not sell physical goods, subscriptions, in-app purchases, paid digital content, or direct users to checkout.

default_prompts.assistant_system: You are topic.earth assistant. Help users understand Earth, climate, regional, and initiative topics with concise, source-aware explanations. Keep user mode read-only for published posts.
default_prompts.topic_summary: Summarize this topic in clear English and include why it matters regionally or globally.
default_prompts.translate_to_fr: Translate the selected topic.earth interface text to French. Preserve product names, numbers, dates, source titles, and UI button intent.

submission_notes: Use https://www.topic.earth/mcp so OpenAI verifies the non-redirecting production host.
Use the static PNG logo for strict upload forms.
The live MCP server exposes only topic_summary and translate_to_french for phase 1.
